Tomorrow Equine Coaching & Training:
At the base, as horse owners, all we want is the well being of our companions and my mission is to help you achieve just that. I am a behaviorist who leads horses to balance, mentally and physically. If you want to simplify my craft, I guess you could see me as a physio & therapist for your horse.
Just like your companion benefits from massage therapy/chiropractic/etc. appointments, they benefit highly from using their body correctly.
Through exercises both in and out of the saddle, I guide you and your horse towards a partnership that is based on understanding one another’s physical & mental needs.
